purpose: Locate writer wall-time distribution; do not infer the cause of the historical VM07 regression without new evidence
cache: Warm input, own-codec preload before timer; no drop_caches, eviction or cold-disk claim. Every output path is new on one filesystem.

runner_monitor.isolation_assurance: sampled process inventory plus operator dedicated-window declaration

measurement_isolation: Sequential only. No SCP/download/upload, builds, compression/collection, other benchmarks or solver work during all 126 samples. Collect after the final sample or after abort.
failure_policy: Abort on first failure/timeout/resource stop, preserve all records; no retry, replacement, adaptive repetitions, threshold or input changes. Incomplete campaigns are not evaluated.
correctness_gate: All outputs and canonical files byte-exact to original inputs and across all six arms, full readback succeeds, all supervised exits/cleanup/identity/host checks pass

calibration.rule: Both ratios must fall within inclusive bounds for that case/codec's phase attribution to be eligible; otherwise publish durations and overhead only, attribution not_evaluated. Never correct phase values by dividing out overhead.
calibration.scope: Prospective instrumentation budget, not an R1 acceptance target or a statistical equivalence test

primary_performance: Compare candidate-plain with baseline-plain only; report six raw paired blocks, medians, min/max and ratios. Do not use on-arm speed as product performance or replace historical VM07 evidence.
required_before_execution: Owner confirms machine availability, cloud authorization/budget/deadline separately; this protocol authorizes no spending
Freeze exact protocol/applier/runtime/validator/source-pin/example/input SHA256 and byte counts before all warmups
Four fresh release builds (plain and instrumented for both revisions), same compiler/Cargo/flags/target; record actual source manifests and successful build logs
Freeze all four binary hashes, source-copy manifests, supervisor/Python/compiler identities, Linux CPU model/features, boot_id, OS/kernel, filesystem/mount and outer cgroup limits
Dedicated finite runner must enforce the declared order, limits and before/after identity/CPU/boot checks; existing run_codec.py is frozen and must not be edited or passed an incompatible plan
No reuse of native target outputs across CPU or boot changes; preemption stops the campaign and requires a new complete prospective plan
explicit_non_claims: physical disk latency or pure compression CPU
